summary: Swift agent resources accept an omitted under relationship list, preserving the distinction between absent and explicitly empty values.

schema.detail: The existing Agent schema already makes under optional; the Swift template and generated model now match it.

compatibility.detail: AgentResource.under is now optional. Swift consumers must handle nil when the daemon omits relationship information; an explicit empty list remains an empty list. Fixture assertions select resource IDs rather than depending on fixture ordering. The test capture session explicitly initializes URLSession on Linux.
